name: Mandarin Oriental Barcelona
insider_take: Where haute couture meets Catalan soul — the Mandarin Oriental Barcelona is luxury distilled on the most glamorous boulevard in Spain.
whats_special: Occupying a stunning 1950s bank building on the iconic Passeig de Gràcia, this property sits literally steps from Barcelona's most celebrated modernist landmarks — Gaudí's Casa Batlló and Puig i Cadafalch's Casa Amatller are practically neighbors. The hotel's rooftop terrace and pool offer jaw-dropping views over the Eixample district, while the celebrated restaurant Blanc delivers refined Mediterranean cuisine with serious culinary credentials.
pro_tip: Book a room on the upper floors facing Passeig de Gràcia for front-row views of the famous "Block of Discord" — three of Barcelona's most extraordinary modernist buildings clustered together in one unforgettable streetscape.
dont_miss: Treat yourself to the hotel's Moments restaurant (two Michelin stars), helmed by chef Carme Ruscalleda's son Raül Balam — it's one of the most celebrated dining experiences in all of Barcelona. And before you head out, stroll the chic private garden terrace for a morning coffee; it's a rare green oasis in the heart of the city.
pros: Prime location on Passeig de Gràcia for luxury shopping and sightseeing
Award-winning spa with rooftop terrace and panoramic city views
Exceptional dining at Moments restaurant with 2 Michelin stars
Elegant contemporary design blending modern luxury with Catalan heritage
cons: Located on busy shopping street with potential traffic noise
